baseline_models.focus_anchor: كَانَ عَلَقَةً فَخَلَقَ فَسَوَّىٰ, with a prior state followed by two fa-linked operations.
baseline_models.mechanism: Temporal occurrence presents conception as a prior state; conception taking hold then feeds origination and internally sound completion.

activation_trace.role: Being or occurrence in time makes the attached condition a prior phase rather than a timeless label.
Conception taking hold supplies the concrete dependent state from which the next operations proceed.
Originating and bringing into being supplies the first transformative operation.
Internal straightness and sound completion supplies the resulting integrity of form.

changed_reading.before: A bare statement that the human was a clot and was then created.
changed_reading.after: A causal developmental sequence in which conception takes hold, is transformed, and reaches coherent bodily completion.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The distinct predicates فَخَلَقَ and فَسَوَّىٰ.
baseline_models.mechanism: Creation contributes setting measure and proportion, while taswiya contributes equivalence and sound completion; the second verb realizes and balances what the first measures.

activation_trace.role: Measuring and proportioning supplies a design-setting operation rather than undifferentiated making.
Equality between parts supplies the balancing operation that follows measurement.
Sound completion supplies the terminal condition achieved by that balancing.

changed_reading.before: Created and made even function as near-synonymous statements.
changed_reading.after: The verbs divide the work into setting proportions and then bringing the measured parts into balanced, sound completion.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The movement from عَلَقَةً to فَسَوَّىٰ.
baseline_models.mechanism: The starting noun can name a relational condition of clinging and dependence; origination converts that dependent attachment into an integrated form with its own internal straightness.

activation_trace.role: Clinging to and remaining on another supplies the initial condition of material dependence.
Origination supplies the transition out of mere attachment into a formed entity.
Internal soundness supplies the endpoint of integrated rather than merely attached existence.

changed_reading.before: ʿAlaqah names only the texture or substance of an embryonic stage.
changed_reading.after: It also names a relation: a dependent, attached state is converted into an internally integrated form.

context_deltas.mechanism: The focus process becomes a precedent for exact reconstitution: gathering dispersed bodily structure, exercising effective capability, and restoring even its extremities clarifies creation and taswiya as precision work.

activation_trace.role: Measuring and proportioning anchors the focus as exact formative work.
Sound completion anchors the finished integrity that reconstitution must restore.
Joining dispersed pieces into one whole supplies the reassembly operation.
Effective capability that reaches action supplies the power connecting first formation to reassembly.
Sound completion explicitly repeats the focus operation in the reassembly challenge.
Fingertips and bodily extremities supply the fine-grained precision test for restored form.

structural_cues: 75:3 poses non-gathering as the challenged claim, and 75:4 answers with fingertip-level taswiya.
The same taswiya predicate appears in 75:4 and the focus ayah.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies bodily gathering, effective capability, extremities, and repeated taswiya; I infer that first formation demonstrates the precision needed for later reconstitution. The live alternative is that 75:38 concerns only first formation while 75:3-4 independently concerns return.

changed_reading.before: The verse describes only initial embryonic formation.
changed_reading.after: It also serves as a small-scale precedent for exact reassembly: attached matter can be gathered, proportioned, and restored down to bodily endpoints.

context_deltas.mechanism: The adjacent generative material carries both semen and determination images; measured creation turns that prior determination into completed form, while the closing capability question treats the accomplished process as evidence of effective power.

activation_trace.role: Measuring and proportioning supplies the execution of a determinate form.
Sound completion supplies the realized endpoint of that execution.
Semen from which form is determined supplies the immediate generative substrate.
Determining and carrying a measure into effect supplies a latent specification image within that substrate.
Capability that reaches action supplies the closing confirmation that the measured process is executable.

structural_cues: 75:37 places maniyy yumna immediately before the focus transformation.
75:40 closes the sequence with a question about effective capability.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies MNY's semen and determination branches, KHLQ's measuring branch, and QDR's effective-capability branch; I infer a specification-to-execution arrow. A live alternative is that determination is only a remote lexical resonance and the local MNY occurrence contributes semen alone.

changed_reading.before: Creation acts on an otherwise unspecified embryonic substance.
changed_reading.after: Creation reads as the execution of a measured possibility already carried by the generative source, brought to completion by taswiya.

context_deltas.mechanism: Repeated gathering of bones, luminaries, and recitation supplies a cross-domain operation of making a coherent whole; this sharpens measured creation and taswiya as relational assembly rather than only production of substance.

activation_trace.role: Measuring and proportioning anchors creation as organized rather than formless production.
Sound completion anchors the coherent whole produced by organization.
Gathering dispersed pieces into one supplies bodily coherence.
Gathering dispersed entities into one relation extends coherence-making to the cosmic pair.
Gathering into a whole extends the same operation to recited discourse.

structural_cues: The same root occurs at 75:3, 75:9, and 75:17 across body, cosmos, and recitation.
The focus returns to bodily formation after those three gathering scenes.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies exact JMA repetition and its joining-disparate-pieces branch; I infer a shared coherence-making operation that illuminates KHLQ and SWY. The live alternative is that the three gatherings remain domain-specific and do not modify the focus mechanics.

changed_reading.before: Creation primarily means bringing a body into existence.
changed_reading.after: Creation and taswiya also mean composing relations into a coherent whole, continuous with the surah's bodily, cosmic, and discursive gatherings.

context_deltas.mechanism: The anti-haste sequence of gathering, reciting, following, and clarification activates the focus connectors as a discipline of ordered emergence: attachment, origination, and completion are successive operations whose order should not be collapsed.

activation_trace.role: Occurrence in time anchors the focus as staged temporal predication.
Conception taking hold supplies the first stable stage in the ordered process.
Origination supplies the next operation rather than an interchangeable restatement.
Sound completion supplies the ordered endpoint.
Hastening or advancing something prematurely supplies the blocked failure mode.
Gathering parts into a whole supplies the first authorized operation after haste is blocked.
Reading and recitation supplies the articulated phase that follows gathering.
Following in sequence supplies ordered reception rather than premature control.
Disclosure of meaning by speech or sign supplies the clarifying endpoint.

structural_cues: 75:16 forbids haste; 75:17-19 then orders gathering, recitation and following, and clarification.
75:38 likewise uses thumma followed by two fa-linked predicates.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies two explicit sequences and branches for haste, gathering, following, and clarification; I infer a process analogy in which the focus grammar protects ordered formation. The live alternative is that 75:16-19 governs recitation alone and has no analogical force for bodily development.

changed_reading.before: The verse compresses a biological result into a short report.
changed_reading.after: Its connectors expose a non-collapsible order: taking hold, origination, and completion unfold as distinct phases, resonating with the surah's anti-haste protocol.

context_deltas.mechanism: The focus begins with attachment and reaches integrated form, while the death sequence supplies separation, limb-wrapping, and compulsory movement; completion therefore becomes a real but mortal stabilization rather than an unqualified endpoint.

activation_trace.role: Clinging and remaining attached supplies life's initial relation.
Sound completion supplies the interval of integrated bodily form.
Distinguishing and separating supplies the terminal reversal of attachment.
Wrapping one thing around another supplies the body's constricted terminal configuration.
Driving or conducting supplies compulsory movement after bodily integration fails.

structural_cues: 75:28-30 moves without interruption from separation to entwined legs and onward driving.
The focus's attachment-to-completion sequence appears after this death scene.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies attachment, separation, wrapping, and driving; I infer a life arc in which taswiya is a temporary integration bracketed by dependence and dissolution. The live alternative is that the death sequence describes only a terminal event and should not qualify the focus's completion.

changed_reading.before: Taswiya is a final and self-contained triumph of bodily completion.
changed_reading.after: Taswiya is genuine integration within a mortal arc: attachment becomes coherent form, then separation and compelled departure undo its stability.

context_deltas.mechanism: The next ayah turns completed form into differentiated pairhood; creation and taswiya are therefore a hinge into generative distinction, not merely the closure of one isolated body's manufacture.

activation_trace.role: Conception taking hold supplies the generative beginning of the focus process.
Origination supplies the transition from conceived material to formed life.
Sound completion supplies the state from which the next differentiation proceeds.
Causing a thing to become a state supplies the transition from completed form to differentiated outcome.
A counterpart joined to its counterpart supplies relational pairhood rather than isolated identity.
Male as counterpart to female supplies one pole of the explicit differentiation.
Female as counterpart to male supplies the other pole of the explicit differentiation.

structural_cues: 75:37-39 is one uninterrupted developmental chain from drop, through the focus, to the two sexed counterparts.
75:39 begins with fa, directly extending the focus's fa-linked operations.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies immediate succession, transformation, pairhood, and explicit male-female distinction; I infer that completed form opens into generative differentiation. The live alternative is that 75:39 merely inventories two created classes without assigning enabling force to the focus's taswiya.

changed_reading.before: The focus ends with the completion of one individual body.
changed_reading.after: Its completion is a hinge into relational and generative differentiation, extending one formation into the paired structure of subsequent life.

context_deltas.mechanism: The closing question maps effective capability, animate life, and loss of life onto the focus process; bringing dependent matter into completed form becomes evidence that life can be restored after its powers depart.

activation_trace.role: Originating and bringing into being supplies the demonstrated first-formation operation.
Sound completion supplies the demonstrated arrival at integral living form.
Capability that enables action supplies the inferential bridge from first formation to restoration.
Animate, ensouled life supplies the state to be restored.
Departure of power and life supplies the reversed condition on which restoration acts.

structural_cues: 75:40 immediately follows the focus and 75:39 as a rhetorical capability question.
The demonstrative in 75:40 can point back across the just-recited formative sequence.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the closing capability question and explicit life-loss opposition; I infer that its demonstrative recruits the focus's completed first formation as evidence for reversal of death. The live alternative is a broader demonstrative referent that does not privilege the focus mechanics.

changed_reading.before: The verse reports a past origin without specifying its argumentative use.
changed_reading.after: The completed first formation is an enacted analogue for restoring life after its powers have departed.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it carries the cloth-warp branch of S-D-Y into embryonic formation. It remains anchored in KHLQ's measuring and SWY's completion and is activated by the immediately preceding question about being left sudā. Downstream prose should present it only as a material analogy, not as a claim that sudā locally means an unfinished textile.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: فَخَلَقَ فَسَوَّىٰ as measured making and completion immediately after 75:36's سُدًى.

activation_trace.role: Measuring and proportioning supplies the shaping of initially unintegrated material.
Sound completion supplies the finished state opposed to being left incomplete.
The warp threads of cloth supply an exploratory image of material awaiting ordered completion.

changed_reading.before: Not being left sudā and being formed are linked only as abstract purposelessness versus purpose.
changed_reading.after: The sequence can briefly picture the human as not left like loose warp: measured creation and taswiya bring a supplied scaffold into finished order.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is branch-distant because KHLQ in the focus most directly denotes creation, not moral character. It remains anchored in KHLQ's inner-disposition branch and in the nearby contrast between truth, denial, turning away, and strutting after bodily formation. Downstream prose should mark it as a contrastive resonance between given form and enacted character, never substitute 'character' for the focus verb.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: فَخَلَقَ فَسَوَّىٰ, with KHLQ carrying both formed body and inner-disposition branch potential.

activation_trace.role: Inner disposition and character supplies the exploratory moral register of the focus root.
Sound completion supplies the given integrity against which enacted distortion is contrasted.
Complete soundness and stability supplies the moral integrity that the subject fails to enact.
Contradiction of truth supplies the first enacted deformation of that integrity.
Turning away supplies the directional enactment of refusal.
Strutting by extending one's bearing supplies the bodily display of self-fashioned distortion.

changed_reading.before: Bodily formation and the subject's denial are unrelated descriptive blocks.
changed_reading.after: The perfectly given form can resonate contrastively with a character the subject enacts out of truth, refusal, and proud bodily display.

strongest_changes: Creation and taswiya become precision operations that can ground exact bodily reassembly.
The focus becomes the hinge of a generative chain, moving from conceived dependence through completed form into paired differentiation.
The closing life-death question recruits first formation as evidence for restoration after loss of life.
Whole-surah repetitions activate coherence-making and ordered-process readings beyond a bare embryological report.
summary.what_was_special: The whole-surah packet exposed repeated gathering across body, cosmos, and recitation, an anti-haste sequence structurally parallel to the focus's connectors, a death sequence that bounds bodily integration, and immediate pre- and post-focus cues that turn 75:38 into the central transformation of a larger generative argument.
remaining_uncertainties: The determination branch of MNY may be resonance rather than an active local contribution.
The recitation-to-formation process analogy is structurally visible but remains cross-domain and exploratory.
The cloth-warp and moral-character readings require explicit containment as branch activations, not local lexical substitutions.
The demonstrative in 75:40 may point broadly rather than specifically to the focus's formative mechanics.
